summary: Fibo 2.0 Dev as ComfyUI's support recommends: Euler, simple, 30 steps, CFG 5, the empty null caption as the negative.
notes: Train on Dev. Edit Turbo is the 4-step, CFG 1 edit build: its settings make Dev previews look broken.
Trained around 1 megapixel (Bria's sizes are multiples of 16 within 10% of 1 MP).
An empty negative is the null caption Fibo 2.0 was trained with for classifier-free guidance.
Fibo 2.0 is trained on structured JSON captions; plain text also encodes.
Captions with text to render: TextEncodeFibo2 shows Qwen3-VL images of that text only below sigma 0.9, while training encodes them at every noise level.
